tools.name: view_file
tools.description: View the contents of a file from the local filesystem. This tool supports text files and following binary files: image, pdf, video, audio.

parameters.name: AbsolutePath
parameters.description: Path to file to view. Must be an absolute path.

parameters.name: ContentOffset
parameters.description: Optional. Byte offset into the content. Use this to view content beyond the initial byte limit when the tool output indicates content was truncated.

parameters.name: EndLine
parameters.description: Optional. Endline to view, 1-indexed, inclusive. When specified, this value must be greater than or equal to StartLine.

parameters.name: StartLine
parameters.description: Optional. Startline to view, 1-indexed, inclusive. When specified, this value must be less than or equal to EndLine.

parameters.name: IsDaemon

parameters.name: WaitMsBeforeAsync

tools.name: schedule
tools.description: Schedule a one-shot timer or a recurring cron job that sends notifications in the background.

parameters.name: CronExpression
parameters.description: A standard cron expression (5 fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week). Use for recurring schedules.

parameters.name: DurationSeconds
parameters.description: The number of seconds to wait. Use for one-shot timers.

parameters.name: IsDaemon
parameters.description: Optional. Set to true only when the cron is an independent, standing job that should keep firing even after your current task is done.

parameters.name: MaxIterations
parameters.description: Optional. Maximum number of times the cron schedule will fire before stopping.

parameters.name: Prompt
parameters.description: The message content to include in the notification when the timer fires or cron triggers.

parameters.name: TimerCondition
parameters.description: Optional. Controls when a one-shot timer should early terminate upon receiving a message. Options: 'never', 'any', or a specific sender ID.
